text:
lauren-devex: heads up — our sample app hit a snag. it needs model metadata (param count / context windows) to pick quantization profiles but the SDK doesn't expose the metadata endpoint like REST does.

sam-sdk: ugh — we pulled the metadata helper last quarter because the schema was unstable. should've left a compatibility shim. can you paste the exact REST path your app calls?

lauren-devex: calling `GET /v1/models/gpt-neo/metadata` via curl works:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/gpt-neo/metadata"
```
but in the node sample app we only get `client.models.get('gpt-neo')` which returns name + id, no params/context. sample app falls back to hardcoded rules which are wrong for some open models.

sam-sdk: thanks. SDK currently only exposes `client.models.list()` and `client.models.get()` with a trimmed shape. we can add `getMetadata` or return a richer shape from `get()`. tradeoffs: bigger payloads for every call vs explicit endpoint.

cheng-plat: fwiw there are two related problems we saw in prod: (1) streaming responses from SDK don't set the same `x-rw-stream-id` header the REST streaming path uses, which breaks our stream-router in dedicated, and (2) auth token TTL differences — SDK rotates ephemeral tokens every 15m but the REST infra accepts tokens for 60m. results in `401` on long-lived streams if SDK rotates mid-stream.

ikram-sre: confirming — seen 401 spikes on private deploys correlating with SDK client auto-refresh. for private we require token TTL parity or make SDK refresh transparent without reauthing the server-sent stream. also the retry behavior: SDK retries on 429/5xx by default with exponential backoff, we found some non-idempotent commands (webhook registrations) get executed twice. we need per-call retry controls.

sam-sdk: good catch. action items i propose:
- add `client.models.getMetadata(id)` mirroring REST path (opt-in)
- add `streaming.headers` normalization so `x-rw-stream-id` present for SDK streams
- expose `retryPolicy` per-client/per-call (allow `retryOn429: false` and honor `Retry-After`)
- add config to align ephemeral token ttl to env var for private deploys (`SDK_TOKEN_TTL_OVERRIDE`)

lauren-devex: sounds good. i'll open a GH issue with a minimal repro (sample app + curl) and link the logs. i'll also add a quick sample patch that prefers `getMetadata` when available and falls back to `get()` -> warn.

cheng-plat: when adding `getMetadata`, please include a tiny integration test that verifies headers on streaming paths (`x-rw-stream-id`) and a e2e that emulates token rotation. caught us a week of sleuthing last time.

deploy-bot: :rocket: rolling canary SDK build 0.14.7 -> adding metadata shim to canary channel, watch for regressions.

lauren-devex: thanks — cc @sam-sdk @ikram-sre. i'll also update the onboarding quickstart to show the recommended pattern (use metadata to choose quantization profile) so new users don't hardcode assumptions.

sam-sdk: i'll take the PR, planning to get this into next patch. thx for the detailed repro, lauren.
